title: 24 - Flink
description: Real Flink job metrics (flink-jobs/statefarm-claims-processor). Audited against the live metric catalog from both pods directly (curl :9249/metrics) - 359 real series exist. Fixed two silently-wrong metric names in place (commitsSucceeded/commitsFailed were missing a KafkaSourceReader_ prefix) and appended job-lifecycle timing, derived real parallelism, full checkpoint/network/buffer detail, hard-vs-soft backpressure, per-topic-partition offset tracking on raw-claims, the full Kafka producer client (sink side), Sink API v2 commit-protocol detail, and JVM completeness for both JobManager and TaskManager - every existing panel from the prior version is kept unchanged. Runs via the native flink.apache.org/v1beta1 FlinkDeployment CRD (flink-kubernetes-operator), not CFK's FlinkApplication.

panels.description: Metaspace growth without bound usually means a classloader leak.

panels.description: Flink's network stack uses direct buffers heavily; separate from heap and can exhaust the container's memory limit even when heap looks fine.

panels.description: An ever-growing thread count usually means a thread leak, most often from a connector client not being closed properly.

panels.description: Additive to the existing GC Time panel above - a high count with low time each means frequent-but-cheap young-gen collections, worth distinguishing from rare-but-expensive full GCs.
panels.title: GC Count (All GCs, JM + TM)

panels.description: cAdvisor container filesystem usage - the pod's writable layer (logs, /tmp), not durable state. RocksDB/durable checkpoint storage metrics do NOT apply to this job: state.backend is 'hashmap' (pure in-memory) and no state.checkpoints.dir is configured, so checkpoints are held in JobManager heap, not written to a PVC or object store - confirmed live, zero rocksdb_* metrics exist in either pod's /metrics output. If this job is ever switched to RocksDB + durable checkpoint storage, that switch would need its own dashboard row (rocksdb-block-cache, num-running-compactions, live-sst-files-size, and the checkpoint storage's own PVC/bucket usage), not something to fake here.
